name: robintech
description: RobinTech agent toolkit — engineering skills and product tooling for coding agents.

plugins.name: robin-cloud-onboarding
plugins.description: Onboard your project to Robin-Cloud end-to-end with an AI agent — analyze the repo, generate Dockerfiles + a keyless CI workflow + nginx, then drive the console setup (GitHub App, ECR, deploy config, DB, custom domain + TLS) with verified checkpoints. No cluster access needed.

plugins.name: arch-explorer
plugins.description: Build an interactive, recursively drillable architecture map of a codebase as a single self-contained HTML file — boxes are modules, labeled arrows are the interfaces between them, and every arrow expands to full signatures with source locations.
